facts.fact: The State Information Service reports that the Government Data and Cloud Computing Center (P1), inaugurated 28 April 2024 on Ain El-Sokhna Road, serves as an active alternative to the New Capital Data Center and as a unified national center for disaster recovery data for government agencies; main site in the New Capital (New Administrative Capital), backup on Ain El-Sokhna Road (town not otherwise stated).
